questions.question: In the study of Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), cold plasma dispersion causes lower-frequency radio waves to arrive later than higher-frequency ones. What is the mathematical relationship between the differential arrival time delay (Δt) between two frequencies (f1 and f2, where f1 > f2) and those frequencies?

For a binary system undergoing inspiral due to gravitational wave emission, which combination of component masses m1 and m2 defines the chirp mass M, which directly sets the rate of frequency increase?
In helioseismology, global resonant modes of the Sun are classified according to their primary restoring force. What are the dominant restoring forces for solar p-modes and g-modes, respectively?
options: Shear viscosity for p-modes; turbulent convective pressure for g-modes
Buoyancy (gravity) for p-modes; pressure gradient (acoustic) for g-modes
Pressure gradient (acoustic) for p-modes; buoyancy (gravity) for g-modes
Gravitational potential gradient for p-modes; magnetic pressure for g-modes

questions.question: The Initial Mass Function (IMF) describes the mass distribution of a single-generation star population at birth. In the differential form dN/dM ∝ M⁻α derived by Edwin Salpeter (1955), what is the value of the power-law index α for stars in the mass range 0.4 M☉ to 10 M☉?

The Jeans mass MJ determines the minimum mass threshold required for an interstellar gas cloud to overcome thermal pressure and undergo self-gravitational collapse. For a cloud of ideal gas with temperature T0 and uniform mass density ρ0, how does MJ scale with T0 and ρ0?
